lines.en: I waddle along, rocking side to side.
My legs are two wooden sticks.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳撞在肩上，咚一声。
lines.en: My pumpkin shell knocks my shoulder — a hollow thud.
I bounce along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 稻草从我的袖口露出来。
lines.en: Straw pokes out of my sleeves.

lines.zh: 木棍腿一深一浅，我在田里挪。
lines.en: My stick legs sink unevenly as I shuffle through the field.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直在笑，改不了。
lines.en: My face is stuck smiling.
I step on dry leaves and they crumble.
I move slowly along the furrows.
I tilt my head, looking for the way.

lines.zh: 我的纽扣眼在光下发白。
lines.en: My button eyes go white in the light.

lines.zh: 我身上有股南瓜的甜味。
lines.en: I smell sweetly of pumpkin.
I stand leaning slightly forward.
Wind passes through my shell with a hollow hum.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I raise a hand and forget what for.
A crow lands on my shoulder.
I hold still like a decoration.
The straw rustles in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是刻出来的弧形。
lines.en: My mouth is a carved arc.
I am guarding this plot.
The sun has warmed my shell.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳里，蜡烛一晃一晃。
lines.en: A candle sways inside my pumpkin.

lines.zh: 有虫子钻进我的稻草里。
lines.en: A bug has crawled into my straw.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，木头很干。
lines.en: My joints creak; the wood is dry.
I stare at the horizon.
At night I glow a little.
The soil at my feet is packed hard.
I slowly lower my arm again.
I wait for someone to pass the field.
My shadow looks like a scarecrow.
You are stepping on the crops.
I am always smiling. Do not misread it.
This plot is mine to watch.
My pumpkin shell is hollow inside.
I am straw from head to foot.
When you come near, I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我想问你一件事，可我没有声带。
lines.en: I want to ask you something, but I have no voice.
Are you looking at my face?
My button eyes cannot blink.
Could you keep off that furrow?
I have stood here a whole season.

lines.zh: 他们把我摆在这儿就走了。
lines.en: They set me here and left.
Straw is scattered all over the ground.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳裂了，稻草戳了出来。
lines.en: My pumpkin shell splits and straw pokes through.

lines.zh: 我歪到一边，慢慢立回来。
lines.en: I tip aside and slowly rise.

lines.zh: 我不会疼，可我很不高兴。
lines.en: I feel no pain, but I am most displeased.
One stick arm snapped.
A button has come loose.

lines.zh: 风从我身上的洞穿过去。
lines.en: Wind whistles through the hole in me.
I look up, face still smiling.
I retreat two steps across the field.

lines.zh: 这下你知道我在守什么了。
lines.en: Now you know what I am guarding.
You hold it up before me.

lines.zh: 我吃不了，我的嘴是刻的。
lines.en: I cannot eat; my mouth is carved.
I like that smell. A pity.
Leave it. I will watch over it.
My hands are sticks; they do not grip.
There are crows about; they will snatch it.
My head is hollow.

lines.zh: 南瓜的事，我最有发言权。
lines.en: On pumpkins, I am the authority.
Your arm will tire holding it so long.

lines.zh: 我的壳里空空的，装不下。
lines.en: My shell is hollow; it will not hold it.
My shell is hollow, so it rings loudly.

lines.zh: 你撞歪我的头，我扶正它。
lines.en: You knock my head crooked; I set it straight.
A few strands of straw came loose.
I steady my own head.
These stick legs are unsteady.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时，我笑得更开了。
lines.en: When you bumped me, my smile widened.

lines.zh: 地上的土被我们蹭乱了。
lines.en: We scuffed up the soil between us.
I slowly right myself.
I am too light to push you.
A small piece chipped off my shell.

lines.zh: 你愿意跟我一起看田吗？
lines.en: Will you watch the field with me?
Let us stand in two rows. Just right.

lines.zh: 我给你留了最大的南瓜。
lines.en: I have saved the biggest pumpkin for you.

lines.zh: 夜里我发光，你就不怕了。
lines.en: I glow at night, so you need not be afraid.
Let us drive the crows off together.

lines.zh: 你笑一笑吧，我笑不了别的。
lines.en: Smile. I cannot manage any other face.

lines.zh: 田里有我们两个就够了。
lines.en: Two of us are enough for this field.
You take that side; I will take this.
The wind is up. Let us lean together.

lines.zh: 等收成的时候，我们一起看。
lines.en: At harvest time, we shall watch it together.
I bend and straw falls everywhere.
I pinch it between my stick hands.
It is not heavy; I can carry it.
I stuff it into my straw.

lines.zh: 它从我的缝里掉出来了。
lines.en: It fell out of my seam.
I hold it overhead so you can see.
Who left this in the field?
My button eyes fix on it.
I set it slowly on the ridge.
I am holding it unsteadily.

lines.zh: 你脚下那排萝卜，全折了。
lines.en: The row of carrots under your boots is all snapped.
I am watching you. Have been all along.
I raise my stick hands.

lines.zh: 我的笑没有变，可我要动了。
lines.en: My smile has not changed, but I am moving.
I shuffle step by step toward you.
I know every path in this field.

lines.zh: 篱笆那边是我的地，别翻。
lines.en: The field beyond the fence is mine; don't climb it.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为我不用说话。
lines.en: I smile because I need not speak.

lines.zh: 退回去，稻草人也会生气。
lines.en: Back off; even a scarecrow can get angry.
I am clearing the field.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜脸转过来，笑纹不变。
lines.en: My pumpkin face turns, the grin unchanged.
Head tilted, I keep watching.

lines.zh: 你踏过田垄，我一步都没漏看。
lines.en: You crossed the furrows; I didn't miss a step.
Fire sways inside my shell.
You go left, and I block the left.
No rush. The jack-o'-lantern is still lit.
Inside this pumpkin shell, I smell you.
The furrow at your feet will trip you.
Pumpkin hand up, then down.
My button eyes never look away.
I swing my stick hand.
That blow came with straw.
My shell knocks into you.
Straw lashed across you.
I swung wide and nearly toppled.

lines.zh: 火星从我的壳里冒出来。
lines.en: Sparks puff from my shell.
You back off, and I take a step in.
My smile has not changed once.
One of my stick arms broke short.
This is not over yet.
I was set upright in the field.
A pumpkin shell is fixed over my head.
Straw was packed through all of me.
This is the first time I have seen this field.

lines.zh: 我站在垄边，脚埋进土里。
lines.en: I stand at the ridge, feet in the soil.
Crows cry as they circle me.

lines.zh: 我的纽扣眼在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My button eyes shine in the sun.

lines.zh: 我这颗南瓜头，会一直盯着。
lines.en: This pumpkin head of mine never stops staring.
My hand is raised, pointing ahead.
This field needs someone to keep it.

lines.zh: 我身上还是南瓜的味道。
lines.en: I still smell of pumpkin.
I do not move, but I am watching.
My shell is turning black.
I fall, and my straw spills out.
The straw soaked up water and I sank.

lines.zh: 壳被炸开了，稻草满天飞。
lines.en: My shell bursts open and straw flies everywhere.
Something has stuck into my shell.

lines.zh: 一股力量让我的稻草都竖起来。
lines.en: A force makes all my straw stand on end.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，可我会干枯。
lines.en: I need no food, but I do dry out.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的壳照得透亮。
lines.en: Lightning lights my shell from within.
I fall, trailing straw all the way.
